items.title: Sam Callahan: Bitcoin Doesn't Need Rate Cuts to Succeed
items.summary: The USD lost 20% purchasing power in 5 years. Sam Callahan breaks down financial repression, core PCE spikes, and the U.S. bond market's historic drawdown. This post Sam Callahan: Bitcoin Doesn't Need Rate Cuts to Succeed first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .

items.title: Michael Howell: Bitcoin as the Apex Liquidity Asset
items.summary: CrossBorder Capital's Michael Howell explains why global liquidity drives markets and why Bitcoin is emerging as the apex asset in a debasement world. This post Michael Howell: Bitcoin as the Apex Liquidity Asset first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
